opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. D. C. Further consideration of question of jurisdiction postponed to hearing of case on the merits. Brief of appellant is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, January 19, 1996. Brief of appellees is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, February 16, 1996. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
